source.title: Relief learning requires a coincident activation of dopamine D1 and NMDA receptors within the nucleus accumbens

confidence_rationale: Direct pharmacological dissociation (intra-NAc SCH23390 + AP5, separate vs co-injected, staged across acquisition/consolidation/expression) showing relief-learning acquisition requires coincident D1 + NMDA activation in the nucleus accumbens -- the same value-coding reward-circuit coincidence that mediates reward learning. Strongly supports MECH-302's core assertion that the relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit machinery. Source quality high (clean within-subject pharmacology, locomotor control rules out perceptual confound). Mapping fidelity high for the 'reuses reward machinery' half of MECH-302; moderate for the downstream tag-and-release pipeline (MECH-057a/091/094), which this paper does not directly test. Transfer risk low-moderate (rat associative paradigm to REE suffering-derivative comparator).
failure_signatures: If REE modelled relief-completion as a wholly separate circuit from reward/goal-achievement, this finding would weaken that design: relief learning shares the NAc D1+NMDA coincidence mechanism with reward learning.

The D1+NMDA requirement is acquisition-specific (co-injection blocked acquisition but not consolidation or expression) -- an REE relief mechanism that gates expression on the same coincidence would be over-specified relative to the biology.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Acquisition of conditioned relief (association of a stimulus with the offset of an aversive event, which later induces appetitive-like behaviour) requires coincident activation of dopamine D1 and NMDA receptors in the nucleus accumbens -- the same accumbal DA-glutamate interaction that mediates reward learning.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-302: the relief-completion event (suffering-stream derivative crossing a downward threshold) reuses the reward/goal-achievement completion pipeline. The NAc D1+NMDA coincidence is the cellular signature of that shared reward machinery; relief is a positive reinforcer carried on the value-coding dopamine channel, not a distinct circuit.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper tests cue-offset relief learning in rats, not a suffering-stream comparator; it establishes shared NAc machinery but does not test the specific downstream REE pipeline (MECH-057a beta-gate drop, MECH-091 phase reset, MECH-094 write gate). 'Same machinery' should be read as 'same value-coding reinforcement substrate', not as identical to REE's commitment-release pipeline.
mapping.source_context: Rat, intracranial pharmacology (intra-NAc SCH23390 D1 antagonist + AP5 NMDA antagonist), relief conditioning with footshock-offset cue.

confidence_components.notes: Clean staged pharmacology with locomotor control; the relief=reward-circuit claim is exactly MECH-302's premise. Weighted toward source_quality + mapping_fidelity for this mechanistic anchor.
